DON'T WAIT.
Jun 2026 • Friends
The last time I ate at Mad Roosta was when the restaurant was still in the Pacific Branch, on the coast of School Sa. The experience did not leave much impression, so this time I did not expect too much. However, Mad Roosta surprised itself rather because the quality of the dish improved significantly.
This time, we visited District 1 on a rainy evening and called Real American Burger, Buffalo Grilled Wings and Mad Fries. Burger has a strong BBQ fever, fresh beef and water, roasted enough. I especially like the piece of cake with extra peas, creating a pretty interesting feeling.
Buffalo Grilled Wings is my favorite. Chicken smells roasted, soft, does not dry and the sour fever part is spicy. Mad Fries is fine, if the cheese flows a little more it will be better.
Eating pretty quickly, only about 5-10 minutes. The enthusiastic, attentive and proactive staff supports us throughout the meal.
The space has many options, from the indoor area with air conditioning, the bar to the outside balcony table. I personally prefer the balcony area because it is airy, you can see the streets and enjoy the pleasant air after the rain.
After this visit, I am quite happy because Mad Roosta has improved significantly from before. This is a place worth returning if you want to eat hamburgers, roast chicken and enjoy beer in a comfortable area in District 1.

Mad roosta
Aug 2025
After three weeks of enjoying delicious Vietnamese food, we were looking for something different and ended up at this restaurant because of the many positive reviews.

The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, which we really appreciated.
However, I honestly don't understand the praise for the food.

The meat was of good quality but unfortunately overcooked, making it very dry.
The bread rolls were old and so overbaked that they were practically burnt and extremely greasy.
The fries were tasty, but the amount of cheese on top was just way too much.

A shame — it seemed promising, but in the end, it was disappointing.
